headings: Our Data Sources and Data Engine
paragraphs: Our mission is to transform data, analytics, and expertise into healthcare commercial intelligence. We help clients uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people, so they can shape tomorrow's healthcare industry. Our software-as-a-service ("SaaS") platform creates new paths to commercial success in the healthcare market, so companies can identify where to go next.

Definitive Healthcare is a leading provider of healthcare data and analytics. We provide accurate, comprehensive information on healthcare providers and their activities, enabling customers to make informed decisions across product development, go-to-market planning, and sales and marketing execution. We also offer claims and consumer analytics built from modeled data on millions of unique consumers to help healthcare organizations target, message, and engage specific healthcare audiences.

Delivered through our SaaS products and solutions, our data is important to the commercial success of our approximately 2,330 customers as of December 31, 2025 and can be applied in ways that ultimately benefit patient access and care. We generally define a customer as a company that maintains one or more active paid subscriptions.

We serve three primary end markets: Life Sciences, Provider, and Diversified. Our Life Sciences customers comprise biopharmaceutical and medical device companies. Providers comprise hospitals, health systems, and other care delivery organizations. Diversified customers include healthcare information technology companies and other organizations operating within the healthcare market, such as staffing firms, commercial real estate firms, financial institutions, and marketing and advertising agencies. Within these organizations, our data serves a broad set of functional groups, including sales, marketing, clinical research, product development, strategy, talent acquisition, and physician network management. Customers access our data products on a subscription basis, and we generate substantially all our revenue from subscription fees.

Definitive Healthcare was founded in 2011 and incorporated as Definitive Healthcare Corp. in May 2021 for the purposes of facilitating an IPO of its Class A common stock, which was completed on September 17, 2021. Our corporate headquarters are located in Framingham, MA. Our primary website address is https://www.definitivehc.com. The information on our website is not incorporated herein or otherwise part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Our SaaS-based healthcare data products and solutions are designed to provide comprehensive, accurate information on the U.S. healthcare ecosystem. We aggregate data on healthcare organizations, providers, services, medical and scientific experts, claims, and consumers. Using deep analytics and data science, our data helps customers make insight-driven strategic decisions, such as finding new markets to enter, building comprehensive go-to-market strategies, accessing tactical information to help target the right decision makers, and improving win rates with detailed contextual information. All of this helps our customers succeed in this important but complicated industry.

Our comprehensive, high quality healthcare data is made up of thousands of data sources and billions of data points that enrich and power our products. We transform this data into intelligence through AI and machine learning algorithms that ingest, cleanse, link, and analyze the data to create powerful new intelligence and analytics. Each new data source and algorithm created by our data science team makes our products more valuable to our clients. Definitive Healthcare delivers a 360-degree, longitudinal view of the healthcare ecosystem and depicts how the ecosystem connects, creating a true barrier to entry.

We operate in a highly fragmented market. We have a competitive advantage that is based on our comprehensive dataset built up over 14 years, our application of the data science, which has created proprietary intelligence and linkages that we do not see elsewhere, and a user interface that provides customers access to answers, not data, in an integrated manner. Our competitive strengths include:

• Proprietary Healthcare-specific Commercial Intelligence. We have built proprietary intelligence via first-party research, aggregated, linked, cleansed, and inferred information from thousands of data sources and we have tied billions of data points together into a comprehensive view of the entire U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

• An Integrated Data and Technology Foundation that Creates a Flywheel of Innovation. Our technology platform provides the foundation for rapid product development and innovation by leveraging our existing data assets to produce new modules and features that solve a growing number of business problems.

• Powerful Go-to-Market Engine. We have a highly efficient and effective go-to-market engine that combines effective marketing with an inside sales force comprised of highly trained, vertically focused sales executives.

• Visionary Management Team with a Track Record of Execution. Our management team has a strong track record of exceptional financial performance and of building an award-winning culture to attract and retain highly talented individuals.

While we believe no competitor matches our breadth of data and intelligence solutions or offers as comprehensive and accurate a commercial intelligence platform, we compete either directly or indirectly with:
• Legacy raw claims data providers, such as Clarivate, IQVIA, and Symphony Health; • Emerging point solution players, such as AcuityMD and MedScout;

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

The market in which we operate is highly competitive, such that if we do not compete effectively, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
If we fail to respond to advances in healthcare commercial intelligence, competitors could surpass the depth, breadth or accuracy of our platform.
If we are not able to obtain and maintain accurate, comprehensive or reliable data, we could experience reduced demand for our platform.
Our growth rates have fluctuated and may not be indicative of our future growth.
We may not achieve or sustain profitability in the future as we increase investments in our business or experience operational challenges.
We could lose our access to our data providers, which could negatively impact our platform and could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
If we are unable to attract new customers and expand subscriptions of current customers, our revenue growth and financial performance will be negatively impacted.
We may fail to offer the optimal pricing and packaging of our solutions, which could negatively impact our growth strategy and ability to effectively compete in the market.
If we fail to offer high-quality customer experience, our business and reputation will suffer.

If we fail to maintain adequate operational and financial resources, particularly if we grow rapidly, we may be unable to execute our business plan or maintain high levels of service and customer satisfaction.
If we fail to protect and maintain our brand, our reputation may be harmed and our ability to attract and retain customers will be impaired.
Changes in the sizes or types of organizations that subscribe to our platform could affect our business and our financial results may fluctuate due to increasing variability in our sales cycles.
If we have overestimated the size of our total addressable market, our future growth rate may be limited.
Our business could be negatively affected by changes in search engine algorithms and dynamics or other traffic-generating arrangements.

paragraphs: You should carefully consider each of the following risk factors, as well as other information contained in this Form 10-K, including "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes. The occurrence of any of the following risks could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations, in which case the trading price of our Class A common stock could decline and you could lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that adversely affect our business.

We generate substantially all of our revenue from sales of subscriptions to our platform and any decline in demand for our platform and the data we offer could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, we derived 96% of our revenue from subscription services, and we expect to continue to generate substantially all of our revenue from the sale of subscriptions to our platform. As a result, the continued use of healthcare provider data, sales intelligence and healthcare market analytics by the healthcare ecosystem is critical to our future growth and success. If the healthcare data market fails to grow, or grows more slowly than we currently anticipate, or if there is a decrease in the use of healthcare commercial intelligence, demand for our platform would be negatively affected. For example, difficult macroeconomic conditions have impacted our existing and prospective customers, which has in some cases resulted in longer deal cycles, more stringent approval processes and deferred purchasing decisions, and we expect this to continue until macroeconomic conditions improve.

Changes in preferences for healthcare commercial intelligence may have a disproportionately greater impact on us than if we offered diversified solutions. Demand for healthcare data in general, and our platform in particular, is affected by a number of factors, many of which are beyond our control. Some of these factors include:
• awareness and acceptance of the healthcare commercial intelligence platform category generally, and the growth and evolution of the category and our addressable market;
• availability of products and services that compete with our platform; • brand recognition;

paragraphs: On January 16, 2024, we completed the purchase of assets comprising the Carevoyance (as the term is defined below) business line of H1 Insights, Inc., a product that helps medical technology ("MedTech") customers to improve segmentation, targeting, and prospect engagement for $13.7 million, subject to closing adjustments. We finalized the purchase price allocations of the Carevoyance acquisition during the fourth quarter of 2024.

On July 21, 2023, we completed the acquisition of Populi, a provider-focused data and analytics company that works with healthcare organizations to optimize physician relationships, reduce network leakage, and expand market share, for total consideration of $54.1 million, consisting of approximately $46.4 million of cash paid at closing, a $0.1 million reimbursement from sellers for working capital adjustments, and up to $28.0 million of contingent consideration, with an initial estimated fair value of $7.8 million, subject to meeting certain revenue metrics during calendar years 2024 and 2025. We finalized the purchase price allocations of the Populi acquisition during the first quarter of 2024. See Note 3. Acquisitions to our accompanying consolidated financial statements.

paragraphs: 本公司之使命為將數據、分析及專業知識轉化為醫療保健商業智慧。我們協助客戶發現正確的市場、機會與人際關係，使其能塑造未來的醫療保健產業。我們的軟體即服務（"SaaS"）平台為醫療保健市場創造新的商業成功途徑，使企業能識別下一步的發展方向。
Definitive Healthcare 是醫療保健數據與分析的領導供應商。我們提供準確且完整的醫療保健提供者及其活動資訊，使客戶能在產品開發、市場進入規劃及銷售與行銷執行方面做出明智決策。我們亦提供基於數百萬獨特消費者建模數據的聲請與消費者分析，協助醫療保健機構針對特定醫療保健受眾進行目標行銷、訊息傳播與互動。
我們的數據透過 SaaS 產品與解決方案提供，對本公司截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日約 2,330 名客戶的商業成功至關重要，且可應用於最終提升患者就醫與照護。我們通常將客戶定義為維持一個或多個活躍付費訂閱的公司。

我們服務三大主要終端市場：生命科學、提供者與多元化。我們的生命科學客戶包括生物製藥與醫療器材公司。提供者包括醫院、醫療系統及其他照護提供機構。多元化客戶包括醫療資訊科技公司及其他在醫療保健市場運作的機構，例如人力派遣公司、商業不動產公司、金融機構及行銷與廣告機構。在這些機構內，我們的數據服務廣泛的功能部門，包括銷售、行銷、臨牀研究、產品開發、策略、人才招募及醫師網路管理。客戶以訂閱方式使用我們的數據產品，我們幾乎所有收入均來自訂閱費用。

Definitive Healthcare 於 2011 年成立，並於 2021 年 5 月註冊為 Definitive Healthcare Corp，以促進其 A 級普通股的首次公開發行（IPO），該發行於 2021 年 9 月 17 日完成。本公司總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗拉明漢（Framingham, MA）。本公司主要網站地址為 https://www.definitivehc.com。本網站的資訊未於本年度報告表 10-K 中引用或包含在內。

我們的 SaaS 服務醫療保健數據產品與解決方案設計用以提供美國醫療保健生態系的全面且準確資訊。我們彙整醫療保健機構、提供者、服務、醫療與科學專家、聲請與消費者數據。透過深度分析與數據科學，我們的數據協助客戶做出以洞察為導向的戰略決策，例如尋找新的市場進入機會、建立完整的市場進入策略、取得協助定位正確決策者的戰術資訊，以及透過詳細的脈絡資訊提高獲勝率。所有這些都有助於我們的客戶在這個重要但複雜的產業中取得成功。

我們的全面且高品質醫療保健數據由數千個數據來源與十億個數據點組成，這些數據豐富並推動我們的產品。我們透過人工智能與機器學習演算法將這些數據轉化為智慧，這些演算法會吸收、清理、連結與分析數據，以創造強大的新智慧與分析。我們數據科學團隊所建立的每個新數據來源與演算法，都使我們的產品對客戶更具價值。Definitive Healthcare 提供醫療保健生態系的 360 度縱向視圖，並展示生態系如何相互連結，創造真正的進入門檻。
我們在一個高度分散的市場中運作。我們的競爭優勢基於我們歷時 14 年建立的全面數據集、我們應用數據科學所創造的專屬智慧與連結，以及提供客戶以整合方式存取答案而非數據的使用者介面。我們的競爭優勢包括：
• 專屬醫療衛生產業商業智慧。我們透過第一手研究，整合、連結、清理及推論來自數千個資料來源的資訊，並將數十億個資料點串聯起來，形成對整個美國醫療衛生生態系統的完整視野。
• 整合式資料與科技基礎設施，創造創新飛輪。我們的科技平台透過善用現有資料資產，快速開發新產品與創新功能，解決日益增多的商業問題，提供產品開發與創新之基礎。
• 強大的市場推廣引擎。我們擁有高效率且有效的市場推廣引擎，結合有效的行銷策略與由高度訓練、垂直領域專注的銷售團隊組成的內部銷售力量。
• 有遠見的管理團隊，具備執行績效紀錄。我們的管理團隊具備強大的財務績效紀錄，並建立獲獎肯定的文化，以吸引並留住高度優秀的人才。
雖然我們相信沒有競爭對手能與我們在資料與智慧解決方案的廣度，或提供更完整且準確的商業智慧平台相提並論，但我們仍直接或間接與以下對手競爭：
• 傳統原始賠付資料供應商，如 Clarivate、IQVIA 和 Symphony Health；• 新興點狀解決方案供應商，如 AcuityMD 和 MedScout；

paragraphs: 於 2024 年 1 月 16 日，本公司完成購入 H1 Insights, Inc. 所屬的 Carevoyance（如後文所定義）業務線資產，該產品協助醫療科技（"MedTech"）客戶改善分羣、目標設定及潛在客戶互動，交易金額為 13.7 百萬美元，扣除交割後調整金額。本公司於 2024 年第四季完成 Carevoyance 收購之買價分攤會計處理。

於 2023 年 7 月 21 日，本公司完成收購 Populi，為一家專注於提供者（provider-focused）的資料與分析公司，協助醫療機構優化醫師關係、減少網路流失及擴大市場佔有率，總交易對價為 54.1 百萬美元，包含於交割時支付約 46.4 百萬美元現金、賣方因營運資金調整而退還 0.1 百萬美元，以及最高可達 28.0 百萬美元之附條件對價，初始預估公平價值為 7.8 百萬美元，視是否達成 2024 年及 2025 年財曆年度之特定營收指標而定。本公司於 2024 年第一季完成 Populi 收購之買價分攤會計處理。詳見我們附屬財務報表之附註 3. 收購。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
我們所處之市場競爭激烈，若我們無法有效競爭，將可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若我們未能回應醫療保健商業智慧之進步，競爭對手可能超越我們平台之深度、廣度或準確性。
若我們無法取得並維持準確、完整或可靠之資料，將可能導致我們平台之需求減少。
我們之成長率有所波動，可能無法反映我們未來之成長情形。
我們可能無法在未來達成或維持獲利，因我們增加業務投資或遭遇營運挑戰。
我們可能失去對資料提供者之存取權，將可能對我們平台造成負面影響，並可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若我們無法吸引新客戶並擴大現有客戶之訂閱數量，將對我們之營收成長與財務表現造成負面影響。
我們可能無法提供我們解決方案的最佳定價與包裝方式，這可能會對我們的成長策略及在市場中有效競爭的能力產生負面影響。
若我們未能提供高品質的客戶體驗，將會影響我們的業務與聲譽。
若我們無法維持充足的運營與財務資源，特別是在我們快速成長的情況下，我們可能無法執行我們的業務計畫或維持高水平的服務與客戶滿意度。
若我們未能保護並維護我們的品牌，將會對我們的聲譽造成損害，並影響我們吸引與留住客戶的能力。
訂閱我們平台的組織規模或類型發生變化，可能會影響我們的業務，且我們的財務結果可能因銷售週期的變動性增加而波動。
若我們高估了我們總可觸及市場的規模，將可能限制我們未來的成長速度。
搜尋引擎演算法與動態或其他流量產生安排的變化，可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響。
在美國境外的業務會使我們面臨國際運營固有的風險
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮下列各項風險因素，以及本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊，包括『管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析』及我們經審計之合併財務報表與相關附註。上述任一風險因素之發生，可能會對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響，進而使本公司 A 級普通股之交易價格下跌，您可能因此損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有我們目前未察覺，或認為不具重大影響之其他風險與不確定因素，亦可能成為影響本公司業務之重要因素。
本公司 substantially all 之營業收入來自於我們平台之訂閱服務銷售，若對我們平台及所提供的資料之需求減少，可能會對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司 96% 之營業收入來自於訂閱服務，我們預期將持續從我們平台之訂閱服務銷售中取得 substantially all 之營業收入。因此，醫療保健提供者資料、銷售智慧及醫療保健市場分析之持續使用，對本公司未來之成長與成功至關重要。若醫療保健資料市場未能成長，或成長速度低於我們目前預期，或醫療保健商業智慧之使用減少，將會對我們平台之需求產生負面影響。例如，困難之總體經濟條件已影響我們現有及潛在客戶，導致在某些情況下，交易週期延長、審批程序更為嚴格及購買新決策延後，我們預期此情況將持續至總體經濟條件改善為止。
醫療保健商業智慧之偏好變動可能對我們產生 disproportionately 更大之影響，若我們提供多元化解決方案，則影響程度可能較低。醫療保健資料之總體需求，以及我們平台之需求，受許多因素影響，其中許多因素為我們所無法控制。這些因素包括：
• 對醫療保健商業智慧平台類別之認知與接受度，以及該類別及其可達市場之成長與演進；
• 提供與我們平台競爭之產品與服務之可得性； • 品牌認知度；
